text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is over. I wonder... Have I
actually
improved?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Once summer is over and fall begins, it'll
finally
be time for the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's only a little ways away, but we've
still got
some time left. I gotta train
super-duper hard
until then!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please continue to watch over
me when
we're back at the academy!
